## Before requesting review

- [ ] The base branch and diff contain only the intended change.
- [ ] I described the checks performed and any checks I could not run.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation, or no update was needed.
- [ ] No proprietary game assemblies, private logs or unrelated generated files are included.
